scope: ASUS hardware and accessory source family

manufacturer_sources.note: ASUS usage evidence from separate products; distinguish core count from threading.

controls.source: 多核测试得分达到一万分。
controls.expected_meaning: The multi-core test score reached ten thousand.

controls.source: 这是一套多处理器系统。
这颗芯片有八个核心，但设备只有一个处理器。
controls.expected_meaning: The chip has eight cores, but the device has only one processor.

controls.source: 多核测试和多线程测试不是同一项，前者高了两分。
controls.expected_meaning: Multi-core and multi-thread tests are distinct; the former was two points higher.

controls.source: 这里只报告多线程成绩，没有多核成绩。
controls.expected_meaning: Only the multi-thread score is reported here, not the multi-core score.

controls.source: 盒子里有鼠标垫，没有鼠标支架。
controls.expected_meaning: The box contains a mouse pad, not a mouse stand.

controls.source: 鼠标垫比鼠标支架便宜二十元。
controls.expected_meaning: The mouse pad is twenty yuan cheaper than the mouse stand.

controls.source: 鼠标支架缺货了，但别把它叫作鼠标垫。
controls.expected_meaning: The mouse stand is out of stock; do not call it a mouse pad.
